title: Web scraping | Scrape Product Information from eBay.com
description: Subscribe and Visit Us https://www.octoparse.com Today, I am going to show you how to extract product information from eBay.com step by step #webscrapingwithoutcoding.   *A complete tutorial*  https://helpcenter.octoparse.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030078432-Video-Scrape-E-commerce-Product-Details-from-eBay-com   *About XPath* https://helpcenter.octoparse.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041118892-Everything-you-should-know-about-XPath-when-using-Octoparse  You don't need to fix the Xpath each time. But you do need to check if it has been correctly set up. If you click through the workflow, and the web browser does the corresponding reaction, it means it is correct. In this case, as you click through the workflow, you will notice from the setting area that says “cannot locate the element with existing XPath expression. And the built-in browser doesn't paginate to the second page. This means we need to fix the Xpath and to tell Octoparse to locate the” NEXT PAGE” button precisely.    ***Ajax & Xpath*** Learn more about AJAX  https://youtu.be/MuOC1yCKai0 Learn more about XPath https://youtu.be/kZwD6szlvas   ***About Us*** Octoparse data extraction: is a #webscrapingtool #webcrawler specifically designed for scalable data extraction of various data types. It can harvest URLs, phone, email addresses, product pricing, reviews, as well as meta tag information and body text. Octoparse is a SIMPLE but POWERFUL web scraping tool for harvesting structured information and specific data types related to the keywords you provide by searching through multiple layers of websites.     ***FREE TRIAL *** Start FREE-14-Days Trial https://www.octoparse.com/signup?ref=homepage   Start FREE-30-Days Enterprise Trial https://www.octoparse.com/contact-sales     ***FOLLOW TEAM ! *** Email: [EMAIL] Skype: octoparse Twitter: @Octoparse Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Octoparse   ***More tutorials about scraping eBay:*** https://helpcenter.octoparse.com/hc/en-us/articles/360022746871-Scrape-product-images-from-eBay https://helpcenter.octoparse.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018707472-Scrape-pricing-from-eBay   #eBay #webscraping #webcrawling  #scrapehotelreviews #dataextractiontool  #scraper #crawling

asr.full_text: Hi everyone, this is Ashley and welcome to Octoparse web scraping tutorial. Let's get started. Before we get started, open up eBay.com using your own browser and type the product category in the search bar. After website finishes uploading, copy the URL. This URL is what we are going to need in this demonstration. Step 1. Enter the URLs of the website you'd like to script. In Octoparse, build a new task by clicking Advanced mode and enter the URL you just copied. And then click Save URL button on the lower left corner. This will bring you to the product category on eBay.com without the parse built-in browser. Step 2. Create a pagination loop. After the website finishes loading up, you can see the interface is divided into three parts. The workflow box on the left, the setting area on the right, and the interactive view of the website on the bottom. On this website, you can see the product listings are spread over different pages. In this tutorial, I will show you how to extract all product information from all pages. To create a pagination loop, scrolling down to the bottom of the page and find the pagination bar, Then click the page next button. The command panel called action tab will show up once it interacts with the website with the action of clicking. It will show you what you can do with the selected element. Then select the LoopClick selected link. Now go back to the setting area. We need to do a few adjustments. Uncheck both the AutoryTry and Ajax load. Speak to Ajax. Many of you probably are confused. What is Ajax? Ajax stands for Asynchronous JavaScript and XML. It means a set of web development techniques that allows web page to update a portion of the content without having to refresh the page. To better understand what Ajax is, let's take a look at Twitter. Twitter uploads the tweets by refreshing part of the web page. When you scroll down to get more tweets, you will notice just the menu bar is refreshed, and the rest of the webpage remains still. That's because Twitter uses AJAX technique. You're able to see the message immediately by only refreshing part of the page, so it saves you time from refreshing the whole webpage whenever a new message comes in. How can you tell the webpage applies AJAX? There are many ways you tell the Web page play with AJAX? There are many ways you can tell if the website uses AJAX. The easiest way is to check the browser tab. When you update a Web page, if there is a loading sign appears, it means the page you are browsing does not apply the AJAX technique. To learn more about AJAX, you can check our website, I have posted a link down below. Make sure you leave comment if you still got any question. Ok, let's go back to Octoparse and finish our scripting task. Click Save to save the process. As you can see, now we finished creating a pagination loop. Octoparse will click through each listing page, and do the exactly same thing as the action we take on first page. Step 3. Create a loop item. To click through each detail page and get further information, we need to create a loop item. To create a loop item, select a product name from the list. As you can see, selected element is highlighted in green color. Other similar items are highlighted in red. You need to pay attention here as you may notice not all laptop names are found and highlighted in red. This is due to an incorrect XPath. XPath stands for XML path . It is a language that allows you to navigate a specific element in an XML document. Web pages are written by human beings and visualized via a web browser. That said, not all webpages follow the same pattern. It could be difficult for a web scriber to crawl a webpage written with messy codes. When should we use XPath? When the scriber cannot locate the specific selected field, you'll need to write an XPath expression, to tell Octoparse to go get the element by defining its specific location in HTML. You can think XPath as a GPS system, which can help you to get your destination by finding the right path. For example, you want to get the product name, but somehow your scripters extract sellers information instead, you need to write an XPath and help your scriper to find the right location. Don't know how to write XPath? Octoparse has a built-in XPath generator, which allows you a hassle-free web scripting experience. To learn more about XPath generator, which allows you a hassle-free web-scripting experience. To learn more about XPath, you can check our website. The related links are listed below. Make sure you leave comments if you still have any questions. Now, let's go back and finish our scripting journey. In this case, we need to come back and fix the XPath. once we finished creating the loop item. OK, so click select all command from ActionTips. Follow the tips and select Loop click each element. This will tell OctoPass to go through each detail page inside the loop item list. Now to go through each detail page inside loops item list. Now, we still need to go back to the setting area and adjust the setting. Uncheck Ajax Load. Now we have a loop item with all parts of details page. We need to fix the XPath. This will tell Octoparse to locate the element and avoid the situation of incomplete extraction. To do this, we need to come back to the loop item on the workflow, and go to the setting area. I have already prepared the XPath for the purpose of the demonstration. Copy this xpath and paste this expression at Variable List I've also attached a tutorial of how to right an XPath down below Click Save to save the step now, we have a loop list with all the detailed pages. OctoPulse will click through each page and do the same exact thing as the action we take on the first item Step 4. Select the data you need. Now you need the Extraction field. As you can see, we have create a loop list, with all detail page in the list. Now, we need to create an action inside the loop item which will tell robot to extract the data within the page. To extract the data, click the element. For example, in this case, we select the name of the product. Click Extract text of the selected element. Click seller, then click Extract text of the selected element from the action tap. Click condition then click EXTRACT text of of the selected element from the ActionTab. Now you can preview the extraction from the data fields and edit. In this case, we added the name. Click SAVE to save the step. Step 5 Run the task and get data. After finishing setting up the rules, we can run the task by clicking Start Extraction. Select the logo extraction to run the task. You can check the Script status and the data has been extracted from the extraction panel. Thanks for watching! Please leave us a comment down below if you have any questions.
